chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from al-Qāsim ibn Yaḥyā, I have transmitted from my father; and from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah; and al-Ḥimyarī, all together, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā and Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim together, from al-Qāsim ibn Yaḥyā.

key_terms.أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, a transmitter in the chain
key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ: Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, a transmitter in the chain
key_terms.الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ يَحْيَى: al-Qāsim ibn Yaḥyā, the narrator to whom this chain leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for the narrations of al-Qāsim ibn Yaḥyā in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from al-Qāsim ibn Yaḥyā in this book. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving the scholarly method of attribution in hadith transmission.
